description: Consumo de electricidad mensual en Castilla y León is a dataset listed in analisis.datosabiertos.jcyl.es open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Junta de Castilla y León. Consumo mensual de energía eléctrica en Castilla y León desde 2019. Los datos incluyen: mes, provincia, código INE de la provincia, suministrador, tipo (residencial, servicios, industrial) y consumo en kWh. Frecuencia de actualización: Mensual. Coverage: Castilla y León. The portal files it under Energy. Its keywords are energía. The portal shows 4,572 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-analisis-datosabiertos-jcyl-es-portal.
